summary: Iteration 99 follow-up of iteration 98. BACKEND: test_manual_solve_reports.py now has 19 tests, run serially with -p no:asyncio -n0. 18 pass and 1 fails. The None-safety fix for solution and solution_accessible_text in preserved() works. New tests that pass: None accessible text and solution, through both preserved/eligible and solve_status; a revoked or demoted owner gets the clear 'Owner access or the original Solve request is no longer valid' error, with no model call and no generic retry text; a source-image question with an owner s_refs solution is preserved (0 jobs, 0 calls), while an answer_key_only source question stays eligible; reviewer role passes staff() but owner() rejects it with 403, and a student is rejected with 403 (in-process test, no new credentials); dispatch_manual starts a worker only for a durable owner_solve row that is queued or has an expired lease, and never for no rows, a non-owner trigger or a live lease; claim_manual ignores non-owner triggers; provider_failure classifies budget/access/model/rate_limit/connection/response, finds a nested __cause__ status (403) and logs parameter markers; and neither the log nor the returned message ever contains injected secret or source markers, including through _call with a mocked SDK error. FAILING (new real bug): manual_solutions.eligible() line 89 calls q.get('text','').strip(), which raises AttributeError when text is None (an existing key whose value is None). Current DB has 0 such fields. test_ai_pause.py passes 16/16 after fixture cleanup; before cleanup its whole-collection baseline guard failed only because the retained TEST_MS fixtures existed. LIVE: I made exactly 1 explicit owner POST on TEST_MS_LIVE-set with a new request_id, and it SUCCEEDED. Job ready, tries=1, model gpt-6-astra, 1249 tokens. The ai_solution was saved with content_hash, final_answer B matches the key, and 1 owner_solve row was added to question_solutions. No failure category was logged. The isolated student completed result (practice attempt, the 1 question skipped) shows the AI solution through /api/attempts/{id}/ai-solutions and in the Results Solutions UI: the 'AI generated' badge, a 10-mark step-by-step solution and rendered LaTeX. No further calls were made. Daily budget used is 1 of 300 (default) on 2026-10-22. FRONTEND at exactly 1920x800 and 390x844: solve-test-options matches the trigger width (788 and 300) across all 144 options with 0 overflowing and no document horizontal overflow (the longest real title is 'Chapter · BITSAT · Aldehydes Ketones & Carboxylic Acids'). question-report-ack is a flex DIV with the icon inline next to the text (21px from the card on desktop, 44px on mobile). The results report strips have 16px left padding. The redundant Solutions shortcut is gone; only the Analysis/Solutions tabs and the PDF download remain. Studio filter labels and counts are consistent: Open 2 / Reviewing 1 / Reviewed 0 / All 3, and filtering returns 1 and 3 rows. BUT in the preview build the filter pill styling and active state are NOT applied on either the Studio reports or the Results filter tabs (details below). Chapter editor /studio/{chapterId} and TEST_MS_LIVE-set editor made only GET /solve requests, with no POST (Solve was never clicked). BonusGate reads rule.main_count and rule.bonus_count dynamically, as confirmed. Production data is unchanged: 144 non-TEST sets, sha256 45baf6bc... identical to iteration 98, 5939 ai tags, question_solutions ready 5939 / paused 1161.

ui_bugs.component: Studio QuestionReportsPanel + Results filter tabs (simple-navigation.css lines 274-275, App.css .filter-tabs > button)
ui_bugs.issue: In the preview dev build, the visual-edits babel plugin wraps every mapped JSX child in <span data-ve-dynamic>. The DOM is therefore div.filter-tabs > span > button, so the child-combinator selectors '.filter-tabs>button' and '.filter-tabs>button.active' never match. Measured: border-width 0, radius 0 (Results) or 12px (Studio), and a transparent background on the active pill. Results 'Incorrect' active looks identical to the inactive pills, and Studio's initially active 'Open' has no highlight. The only Studio highlight comes from the ghost-button hover background. Production builds do not wrap, but the preview the user sees is broken. Fix: use descendant selectors such as '.filter-tabs button' and '.filter-tabs button.active' (or [aria-pressed=true]).

critical_code_review_comments: provider_failure() is safe: it only logs category, status, type and an allowlist of parameter names, never str(exc). Note that the 'text' used for classification is the provider text in memory only. Verified that no secret or source marker leaks into the log or the message.
The run_manual 403 mapping now gives a clear, non-retry message. Verified for a demoted (reviewer) principal and for a forged job.
dispatch_manual from maintenance (jobs.py:280) only spawns for trigger=owner_solve rows that are queued or have an expired lease. Verified that it does no discovery.
The mutable BaseDocument default for ManualJob.solution and provenance is fine. request_solve still returns 200 with 0 jobs when nothing is eligible, which is harmless.
The live call succeeded with the existing configuration, so the iteration 98 failure was transient or since resolved. There was no failure in this run, so no failure category was captured.

rca of the issue: Filter pills: the preview dev server enables the visual-edits babel-metadata-plugin (craco enableVisualEdits=isDevServer), which wraps dynamic expression children (arrays from .map) in a <span>. The child combinator '.filter-tabs>button' therefore fails, and Tailwind preflight (border-width:0, transparent background) wins. Reproduce: open /results/{id}?view=solutions or /studio, then inspect: button.parentElement.tagName === 'SPAN'. Mitigation: use descendant selectors. eligible() None: dict.get('text','') returns None when the key exists with value None; use (x or '').
